condition_other: Depression, epilepsy, Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease are discussed as target applications, but no clinical population or subject was actually stimulated with ultrasound in this study.
readout_other: Pre-existing public fMRI dataset (psychiatric classification) and NIRS dataset (26 participants performing cognitive tasks) were used to validate the framework computationally; neither dataset involved ultrasound stimulation.
direction_notes: This is a computational/simulation framework (IFURTICS) benchmarked against other published systems (LIPUS, LI-FUS, LIFUP, IDNS) using simulated beam profiles and pre-existing imaging datasets; no ultrasound was delivered to any human, animal, or tissue subject, so no neuromodulatory direction of effect could be assessed from this paper.

flags.reason: This paper does not describe an empirical TUS experiment: it is a proposed computational/closed-loop framework ('IFURTICS') validated only via simulation (MATLAB Field II, k-space beam models) and by re-analysing pre-existing public fMRI/NIRS datasets collected for unrelated purposes (psychiatric classification, cognitive tasks). No subject, animal, or tissue was exposed to ultrasound. Recommend scope re-check before publishing to the archive.
No real subjects were exposed to ultrasound; the NIRS dataset (26 participants) and fMRI dataset used for validation involved no TUS delivery, so a meaningful n_subjects cannot be given.

Table 9 values ('Optimal Frequency', 'Beam Intensity') are presented as illustrative/optimal simulated specifications per target, not as measured or delivered exposures to any real subject. Domain (free-field vs in-situ) for 'Beam Intensity' is not stated.
No real human, animal, or tissue subject received ultrasound; model_system 'other' is a best-effort placeholder for a purely computational study.
Hardware is virtually simulated ('the hardware components are simulated virtually by means of high-performance computing systems'); no physical transducer or manufacturer is used or named.

Reported comparison tables (targeting accuracy, off-target effects, therapeutic outcomes, temporal factors) for IFURTICS and comparator systems (LIPUS, LI-FUS, LIFUP, IDNS) appear to be simulated/illustrative rather than empirically measured, and are not reproduced here as exposure fields.

No real subject was exposed to ultrasound; 'human_healthy' is used only because the pre-existing fMRI/NIRS datasets used for computational validation were collected from human participants (for unrelated purposes), not because any human received TUS in this study.

provenance.notes: This paper proposes and simulates a closed-loop tFUS+fMRI/NIRS control framework; it does not report an experiment in which ultrasound was applied to a subject. Most fields are not_reported/null for this reason; see flags.
